description_en: Exports events that occur on a cloud desktop from an Alibaba Cloud Workspace client
kebab_example: aliyun ecd export-client-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --end-user-id user01 --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --desktop-name testName --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --office-site-name test --event-type CLIENT_LOGIN --start-time 2022-03-23T04:10:21Z --end-time 2022-03-23T07:11:01Z --event-types CLIENT_LOGIN --lang-type zh-CN --max-results 50 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportClientEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint user
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the event that you want to query. If you provide multiple values for EventTypes, the response will include events of all the specified types. If you provide no values for EventTypes and EventType, the response will include all events in the designated region.

Valid values:

DESKTOP_STOP: the shutdown event.
GET_LITE_CONNECTION_TICKET: the event of retrieving the connection ticket.
DESKTOP_DISCONNECT: the session disconnection event.
CLIENT_LOGIN: the user logon event.
GET_CONNECTION_TICKET: the connection credential retrieval event.
DESKTOP_REBOOT: the restart event.
DESKTOP_CONNECT: the session establishment event.
DESKTOP_START: the start event
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件类型。当EventTypes不为空时，则以EventTypes组合类型为查询过滤条件。当EventTypes为空，且EventType为空，则查询所有事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify a value for this parameter, all events that occurred before the point in time that you specify for `EndTime` are queried
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。   
如果不填，则按`EndTime`指定的时间往前查询
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。    
如果不填，则按当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The types of the events that you want to query. You can include multiple event types, and the response will return events matching the specified types or all events if none are specified
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件类型组合，可以多个事件组合，查询结果包含所有组合的事件
parameters.name: event_types

parameters.help_en:
The language displayed on the frontend page. The backend uses this setting to define the language of exported files.

Valid values:

zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.
en-GB: British English
parameters.help_zh: 前端页面显示的语言类型，后端根据该语言类型设置导出文件的语言类型
parameters.name: lang_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 5000.
Default value: 5000
parameters.help_zh:
导出的记录数量。
最大值：5000。
默认值：5000
parameters.name: max_results

Url.description_en: The download URL of the exported files
Url.description_zh: 事件导出列表的下载地址
